title: British Pound sticks to losses vs firmer USD as Fed-BoE divergence favors bears
summary: The GBP/USD pair struggles to capitalize on Friday's goodish rebound from the 1.1335 area, or its lowest level since July 30, and attracts fresh sellers at the start of a new week.

title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Trades near 180.50 after breaking above nine-day EMA
summary: EUR/JPY extends its gains for the second consecutive day, trading around 180.40 during European hours on Monday. Technical analysis of the daily chart shows the currency cross trading within a descending channel, keeping the overall bearish bias.
